topic: Day 103 — reel — Readiness is often the last thing to arrive, not the first
text:
Readiness
shows up [after]
you start.
Not before.
caption:
Waiting for the internal green light has the order backward. Willingness comes first and the feeling of being ready catches up later.

Follow for one of these a day.
